cards.ex: The traffic is bumper-to-bumper on the highway, so we're going to be late.
cards.exUz: Trassa tirbandligi juda zich, shuning uchun biz kechikamiz.
cards.uzDef: Mashinalar bir-biriga juda yaqin, juda sekin harakatlanadi.

cards.ex: I'm tired of driving, can you take the wheel for a while?
cards.exUz: Men haydashdan charchadim, biroz rulga o'tira olasizmi?

cards.ex: We made good time on the way here because there wasn't any traffic.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yerga tez yetib keldik, chunki tirbandlik yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan manzilga tez va oson yetib borish.

cards.ex: I always try to book a direct flight to avoid the hassle of layovers.
cards.exUz: Men har doim to'g'ri reysga buyurtma berishga harakat qilaman, shunda to'xtash joylarining tashvishidan qochaman.

cards.ex: Traveling during off-peak hours can save you a lot of money.
cards.exUz: Soatdan tashqari vaqtda sayohat qilish sizga ko'p pul tejashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositalarining eng kam ishlatiladigan vaqtlari.

cards.ex: Let's take the scenic route even if it takes a bit longer.
cards.exUz: Keling, go'zal yo'ldan boraylik, agar u biroz ko'proq vaqt olsa ham.

cards.ex: I prefer to use public transport rather than drive in the city.
cards.exUz: Men shaharda mashina haydashdan ko'ra jamoat transportidan foydalanishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Avtobuslar, poyezdlar va tramvaylar kabi umumiy transport.

cards.ex: There was a car accident on the bridge, causing major delays.
cards.exUz: Ko'prikda avtohalokat sodir bo'ldi, bu katta kechikishlarga olib keldi.

cards.ex: We were stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour.
cards.exUz: Biz bir soatdan ko'proq tirbandlikda qolib ketdik.

cards.ex: Road works on the highway are causing significant delays.
cards.exUz: Trassadagi yo'l ishlari sezilarli kechikishlarga olib kelmoqda.

cards.ex: The project finally got the green light, so we can start planning.
cards.exUz: Loyiha nihoyat ruxsat oldi, shuning uchun biz rejalashtirishni boshlashimiz mumkin.

cards.ex: The plane is scheduled to take off at 3 PM.
cards.exUz: Samolyot soat 15:00 da havoga ko'tarilishi rejalashtirilgan.

cards.ex: We're about to touch down in London.
cards.exUz: Biz Londonga qo'nishga yaqinmiz.

cards.ex: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Bizning mashinamiz hech kim yo'q joyda buzilib qoldi.

cards.ex: Driving in the rush hour is always stressful.
cards.exUz: Tig'iz paytda mashina haydash har doim stressli.

cards.ex: It's just a short hop from here to the airport.
cards.exUz: Bu yerdan aeroportga qisqa masofa.

cards.ex: I missed my connection due to the delayed first flight.
cards.exUz: Men birinchi reys kechikgani sababli reysni o'tkazib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Bitta reysni o'tkazib yuborib, ikkinchi reysga kechikish.

cards.ex: He used to hitchhike across Europe when he was younger.
cards.exUz: U yoshligida Yevropa bo'ylab yo'lovchi so'rab yurardi.

cards.ex: I had to hit the brakes to avoid hitting a deer.
cards.exUz: Men bug'uni urib yubormaslik uchun tormozni bosishga majbur bo'ldim.

cards.ex: The train to Boston departs from platform 5.
cards.exUz: Bostonga boradigan poyezd 5-platformadan jo'naydi.

cards.ex: I need to find a bus route that goes downtown.
cards.exUz: Men shahar markaziga boradigan avtobus yo'nalishini topishim kerak.

cards.ex: Everyone, please get on board, we are about to leave. Or, 'I'm glad you got on board with my plan!'
cards.exUz: Hamma bortga chiqing, biz ketmoqchimiz. Yoki, 'Mening rejamni qo'llab-quvvatlaganingizdan xursandman!'

cards.ex: I had a fender bender in the parking lot this morning.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab avtoturargohda yengil avariyaga uchradim.

cards.ex: We like to scooter around the city on weekends.
cards.exUz: Biz dam olish kunlari shaharda skuterda aylanishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.

cards.ex: It's safer to ride your bike in the bike lane.
cards.exUz: Velosipedni velosiped yo'lida haydash xavfsizroq.

cards.ex: I often get motion sickness on long car rides.
cards.exUz: Men ko'pincha uzoq mashina sayohatlarida harakat kasalligiga duch kelaman.

cards.ex: She's been at the helm of the company for five years.
cards.exUz: U besh yildan beri kompaniya boshqaruvida.

cards.ex: It took me a few days to get my sea legs on the cruise.
cards.exUz: Menga kruizda dengizga moslashish uchun bir necha kun kerak bo'ldi.

cards.ex: We booked our vacation through a travel agency.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'tilimizni sayyohlik agentligi orqali bron qildik.

cards.ex: You always have to go by the book when flying internationally.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro reyslarda uchganda har doim qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
